title: Ensure 'Prevent users from modifying settings' is set to 'Enabled'
registry_path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender Security Center\App and Browser protection\DisallowExploitProtectionOverride
powershell_check: try { (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender Security Center\App and Browser protection' -Name 'DisallowExploitProtectionOverride' -ErrorAction Stop).DisallowExploitProtectionOverride } catch { 0 }
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Security\App and browser protection\Prevent users from modifying settings to 'Enabled'
reason: Only authorized IT staff should be able to make changes to the exploit protection settings.

title: Ensure 'No auto-restart with logged on users for scheduled automatic updates installations' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Update\Legacy Policies\No auto-restart with logged on users for scheduled automatic updates installations to 'Disabled'
reason: Some security updates require that the computer be restarted to complete an installation. Without the auto-restart functionality, users who are not security-conscious may choose to indefinitely delay the restart.

title: Ensure 'Configure Automatic Updates' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Update\Manage end user experience\Configure Automatic Updates to 'Enabled'
reason: The Configure Automatic Updates setting can help you ensure that the computers in your environment will always have the most recent critical operating system updates.

title: Ensure 'Configure Automatic Updates: Scheduled install day' is set to '0 - Every day'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Update\Manage end user experience\Configure Automatic Updates: Scheduled install day to '0 - Every day'
reason: Ensure that the computers in your environment will always have the most recent critical operating system updates installed every day.

title: Ensure 'Manage preview builds' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Update\Manage updates offered from Windows Update\Manage preview builds to 'Disabled'
reason: It can be risky for experimental features to be allowed in an enterprise managed environment because this can introduce bugs and security holes into systems.

title: Ensure 'Select when Quality Updates are received' is set to 'Enabled: 0 days'
powershell_check: try { $a = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'DeferQualityUpdates' -ErrorAction Stop).DeferQualityUpdates; $b = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name 'DeferQualityUpdatesPeriodInDays' -ErrorAction Stop).DeferQualityUpdatesPeriodInDays; if ($a -eq 1 -and $b -eq 0) { 1 } else { 0 } } catch { 0 }
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Update\Manage updates offered from Windows Update\Select when Quality Updates are received to 'Enabled: 0 days'
reason: Quality Updates can contain important bug fixes and/or security patches, and should be installed as soon as possible.
